description:
G5 of the DB-backed TODO tracker migration (_project/specs/todo-db-tracker.md,
'Cutover plan'). DESTRUCTIVE / near-irreversible: freezes and deletes the legacy
YAML system and cuts all routing + skills over to the DB tracker. G1-G4 and G6 are
done; the DB is live (import + G4 sweep applied + weekly export auto-merging).

MAINTAINER-GATED: execute only on explicit authorization. Do w0 (final export
snapshot) FIRST as the rollback point. Land as ONE reviewable PR.

Rollback: before this lands, the YAML tree is untouched (discard the DB to abort).
After: `todo export` output + git history reconstruct the YAML tree.

Steps are the work units below (dependency-ordered).

anti_patterns.dont: delete the 6 scripts without removing their CI/content-guard references in the same change
anti_patterns.why: CI would break on missing todo_cli.py/validate_todo.py

anti_patterns.dont: delete the YAML trees or scripts before w0's final export snapshot is committed
anti_patterns.instead: complete w0 first and confirm the snapshot is on the branch
anti_patterns.why: the snapshot is the only rollback point once the trees are gone

preserves.behavior: git history of _project/TODO and _project/DONE (retained after deletion)

verifications.description: DB tracker reads still work post-cutover

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 (merged 2026-07-19, merge commit 6fde4cd3) contains the final cutover snapshot/rollback provenance; current origin/develop is 8fdd4336 and the legacy trees are absent while history remains in Git.
work_units.summary: Commit a final `todo export` snapshot as the rollback point; record the develop SHA in the PR/spec.

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 merge commit 6fde4cd3 deleted _project/TODO and _project/DONE; current origin/develop has zero tracked paths under either tree, with history retained by the merged Git change.
work_units.summary: Delete _project/TODO/ (131 files) and _project/DONE/ (1240 files); git history retains them.

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 merge commit 6fde4cd3 deleted TODO_SCHEMA.yaml, TODO_ENTRY_TEMPLATE.yaml, _indexes machinery, and legacy structure material; current origin/develop confirms those paths are absent.
work_units.summary: Delete TODO_SCHEMA.yaml, TODO_ENTRY_TEMPLATE.yaml, the _indexes/ machinery, and references/structure.md.

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 merge commit 6fde4cd3 deleted the six retired YAML-tracker scripts and their tests; current origin/develop confirms all six script paths are absent.
work_units.summary: Delete the 6 retired scripts (validate_todo, generate_indexes, migrate_todos, migrate_todo_format, normalize_done_yaml, todo_cli) and their tests.

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 merge commit 6fde4cd3 removed legacy content-guard/path-filter and todo_cli.py/validate_todo.py CI references; current origin/develop grep shows no such active references under .github, Makefile, or _project/scripts.
work_units.summary: Retire the path-filters.yml/content-guard _project/TODO|DONE checks and any CI refs to todo_cli.py/validate_todo.py.

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 merge commit 6fde4cd3 adopted the DB tracker and retired the legacy todo skill actions; current origin/develop contains skill-sync.yaml/lock and the DB-backed todo wrapper, and skill-sync verification passes.
work_units.summary: Adopt todo-db into skill-sync.yaml (remove from ignore); repoint/retire the legacy `todo` skill's cli/validate/tracker actions; shrink its SKILL.md.

work_units.evidence: PR #1232 merge commit 6fde4cd3 updated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md to the DB CLI policy; current origin/develop AGENTS.md states the shared DB is the only TODO record and _project/scripts/todo is the only write path.
work_units.summary: Update AGENTS.md 'Planning & TODOs' and CLAUDE.md pre-approved commands to the DB CLI (todo reads auto-allowed, writes per policy).
